{{Quote|Ah, this must be the survey equipment I requested. Excellent! But where is Mullud? Did that lazy good-for-nothing get someone else to do his work again?|Sentellus Gavrel, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Mullud Bombo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who resided in the small [[Ocean/Legends|oceanside]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bombo worked closely with the wealthy socialites of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], handling deliveries and other odd jobs. However, Bombo generally disliked the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], and he garnered something of a reputation for his laziness.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Heyo. Yousa be needin a task? My be needin someone to hep mesa. Yousa no needin to be smarty. Just needin to tek a gizmo to Naboo maxibig patron. Mesa be payen for de hep. Yousa hep mesa?"<br />"I think you want me to deliver some equipment. To who exactly?"<br />"Yousa needin to go to see Sentellus Gavrel. He be maxibig patron wit mooie mooie moolah. Mesa bosses tink wesa be needin to kiss hisan feet. Make mesa sick!|Mullud Bombo and a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] by the name of Mullud Bombo had set up shop in the small [[Ocean/Legends|oceanside]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] on the lush<ref name="AED" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During his time there, Bombo became acquainted with the socialites of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], and carried out odd jobs for individuals like [[Sentellus Gavrel]], a wealthy patron of his. While Bombo's Gungan [[Boss/Legends|bosses]] believed in placating individuals like Gavrel, Bombo held something of a disdain for the Naboo people on account of what he perceived to be their elitist demeanor. As such, Bombo acquired a reputation for laziness, hiring others to carry out his work.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Such was the case when Gavrel requested Bombo to deliver to him a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] of survey equipment. Instead of delivering the shipment himself, Bombo enlisted the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] passing through Kaadara. In exchange for a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] reward, Bombo delegated to the spacer the responsibility of carrying the backpack to Gavrel outside of the city. However, the journey was not uneventful. In the wilderness, the spacer was attacked by a native [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]] and a wayward [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], both of which were dutifully dispatched. Upon receiving the survey equipment, the wealthy patron, who also worked as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]], derided Bombo for his lack of work ethic. Regardless, Bombo was quite pleased with how the delivery assignment was carried out, and offered the spacer some medicine to make them feel better after their wilderness voyage. It would not, however, be the last assignment for the intrepid spacer. Bombo further employed the individual to receive from [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Siyanna Kaelish]], a female [[entertainer]], a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] containing a list of rich Naboo socialites who were to be invited to a party. Although two Gungan outcasts violently interfered with the transaction, both were dealt with, and Bombo compensated the spacer for resolving the situation. Bombo further employed the spacer to escort another woman, an [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] by the name of Lady [[Winella Munkus]], safely back to Kaadara. Once again, the spacer faced a violent altercation while Bombo remained safely in Kaadara. This time, an aggressive [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] accompanied by a [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]] attempted to prevent Lady Munkus from accompanying the spacer on the journey back to city. However, the spacer [[Death/Legends|killed]] both of them for endangering Munkus' life.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mesa no like whensa dosen others tink dey so smarty den usan. Dey stinkowiff! But yousa seem okeyday.|Mullud Bombo, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:MulludBomboKaadara.png|180px|thumb|Mullud Bombo in Kaadara]]
Mullud Bombo belonged to a lineage of the Gungan [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the Otolla. Like many Otolla Gungans, he had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange, mottled skin. He also spoke a strongly accented form of [[Gungan (language)|Gunganese]],<ref name="AED" /> a [[Language/Legends|language]] derived from the Naboo settlers' language, [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Although Bombo worked closely with Naboo's wealthy elite, he generally disliked the people of Naboo, because he believed they thought too highly of themselves. The fact that his bosses believed in groveling before individuals like Sentellus Gavrel left Bombo feeling "sick." Regardless, he carried out tasks for people like Gavrel, albeit in a manner which garnered him a reputation for laziness.<ref name="AED" />

Instead of carrying out deliveries himself, Bombo would employ others to carry out his assignments. This penchant for laziness compelled Gavrel to view him in a less than sympathetic light. Gavrel also felt Bombo was too difficult to understand, due to his Gunganese. Despite his disdain for the wealthier socialites of Naboo, Bombo was appreciative of outsiders who did as they were instructed. The spacer who helped to deliver the backpack of survey equipment, for instance, was duly complemented by Bombo, and even offered medicine for daring to venture out into Naboo's wilderness. Conversely, Bombo was liable to harshly impugn anyone who refused to help him on his assignments. He viewed such individuals as no different than the "smarty others" he often worked for.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
[[File:MulludBomboBackpack.png|150px|thumb|Sentellus Gavrel hired Mullud Bombo to deliver a backpack containing survey equipment.]]
{{Quote|Yousa done a berry good job. Here, tek dis medicine. It hep yousa feel bettah.|Mullud Bombo, to the spacer who successfully delivered survey equipment to Sentellus Gavrel|<ref name="AED" />}}
During his time in Kaadara, Bombo wore a simple brown tunic and pants. The [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] he wore was strikingly similar to that worn by other Gungans throughout Naboo,<ref name="AED" /> including [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who wore similar attire during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Mullud Bombo was also stocked with other provisions, like the medicine he offered to the spacer after successfully delivering survey equipment to Gavrel.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mesa no like yousa! Off wit yousa! Yousa no better dan dosen smarty others. Yousa all stinkowiff!|Mullud Bombo, to players who refused to accept his quest|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[W:c:swg:Mullud Bombo|Mullud Bombo]] was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who performed a series of [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for Bombo had to deliver a [[W:c:swg:Backpack|backpack]] to Sentellus Gavrel, receive a [[W:c:swg:Datadisc|datadisc]] from Lady Siyanna Kaelish, and escort Lady Winella Munkus back to [[W:c:swg:Kaadara|Kaadara]]. It should be noted, however, that the quest line for Mullud Bombo was rather buggy. While the first quest to deliver a backpack to Gavrel functioned properly, the following two quests lacked any text dialogue strings. This renders it impossible to know the exact context for why Bombo wanted a datadisc from Lady Kaelish, and why he wanted Lady Munkus escorted to Kaadara. Nevertheless, these two quests could still be completed. After completing the first quest, Bombo offered the player some medicine, but no such item was placed in the player's [[W:c:swg:Inventory|inventory]]. Furthermore, while the first two quests would award the player with 50 [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]],<ref name="AED" /> the final quest lacked any reward due to a database error.<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref> As part of a [[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]] update on [[October 8]], 2003, the developers fixed many quest bugs for static quests.<ref name="Publish3">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> At some point during or after this update, the Mullud Bombo NPC was deactivated, and could no longer issue quests to players. Although the player could choose not to do Bombo's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="AED" />
